name: Workspaces API
description: Regression tests for the workspace endpoints of Requesto's own backend. The suite is self-contained: 'Create Workspace' captures the id and path, later requests operate on that scratch workspace, and 'Delete Workspace' cleans up. Note that 'Activate Workspace' temporarily switches the active workspace while the suite runs.

requests.name: List Workspaces
requests.documentation:
# List Workspaces

Lists workspaces and asserts the active workspace id is present. The current active workspace id is saved to activeWorkspaceIdBefore for later assertions.

requests.name: Get Active Workspace
requests.documentation:
# Get Active Workspace

Fetches the active workspace and asserts it matches the listing from the previous request.

requests.name: Create Workspace
requests.documentation:
# Create Workspace

Creates the workspace this suite runs against. Its id and path are saved to createdWorkspaceId and workspacePath, and Delete Workspace removes it at the end of the run.

requests.name: Activate Workspace
requests.documentation:
# Activate Workspace

Makes the created workspace active and asserts the switch took effect.

requests.name: Export Workspace
requests.documentation:
# Export Workspace

Exports the created workspace, asserting the bundle carries the workspace name plus the collections.json and environments.json payloads.

requests.name: Inspect Workspace Path
requests.documentation:
# Inspect Workspace Path

Checks that the created workspace path (passed encoded via {{workspacePathEncoded}}) exists on disk as a directory.

requests.name: Delete Workspace
requests.documentation:
# Delete Workspace

Removes the created workspace at the end of the run.
